title: Cards for events, sermons, ministries and Life Groups in a post
question: A post can now hold a card for something in the app, chosen from Insert. Each sketch shows the same post three ways: as people read it, as it looks while you write it (the card itself, with move, replace and take-out controls; nobody sees ::event{…}), and the other states (a cancelled event, a regular event shown as its pattern, a finished sermon, one that's gone). Scroll inside each phone. Pick the card design; the other two go.

options.label: A rule down the side
options.thesis: No box: each card is set into the text behind a coloured rule (aqua for an event, navy for a sermon, the ministry's own colour), with a small capital kicker, the details, a square picture at the right and its actions as words (Add to calendar · Open). It reads as part of the post, like a quote does.
options.viewport: Carols on the lawn with its rule, time, place and change note, Add to calendar · Open; then the sermon with its progress.
options.risk: The quietest of the three: an event's Add to calendar is words, not a button, and a card can be passed over as a quote.

options.label: A line in the bulletin's timetable
options.thesis: Like the bulletin's This week: a column at the left carries the day and date in large type for an event (EVERY SUN for a regular one), the artwork for a sermon, the ministry's coloured icon; the details at the right with real buttons. Hairlines above and below rule it off from the text.
options.viewport: SAT 20 DEC block beside Carols on the lawn with Add to calendar and Open; then the sermon's artwork beside its title and progress.
options.risk: An event's picture isn't shown (the date leads); a post with several cards reads like a list.

options.label: A box from the bulletin
options.thesis: Each card is a sand box at the card radius: an event's picture across the top (a ministry's colour and icon where it has none), then the kind and date, the title in a larger size, the details and a wide main button. The strongest presence: it reads as something to do.
options.viewport: Carols on the lawn's picture, then its date line, title, time, place, change note and a wide Add to calendar beside Open.
options.risk: Big: two or three cards take over a short post, and a ministry's colour block stands in for a picture it doesn't have.
